title: feat(electron): surface broken links in backlinks panel
body:
## Summary

  Surface broken wiki and local markdown links in the existing Backlinks panel.

 ## Motivation
  
The electron demo already resolves wiki links and shows backlinks, but users currently do not have a focused way to find unresolved links in the active note.

  This PR adds a lightweight broken-link diagnostics section to the existing Backlinks panel without changing the overall app structure.

  - Issue:
  - Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md):
  - OpenSpec change:

  ## Changes

  - `apps/electron-demo`:
    - Add `LinkIndex.getBrokenLinks()` for unresolved links in the active file.
    - Detect unresolved wiki links such as `[[Ghost]]`.
    - Detect missing wiki anchors such as `[[Foo#Missing]]` and `[[Foo^missing-block]]`.
    - Detect missing local markdown file links such as `[missing](../docs/Missing.md)`.
    - Exclude external URLs such as `https://example.com/file.md`.
    - Show a `Broken links` section in the existing Backlinks panel.
    - Jump to the broken link position when clicking an item.
    - Add vitest coverage for unresolved wiki links, missing anchors, local markdown links, and external URL exclusion.

  ## Testing

  - [x] `pnpm exec vitest run apps/electron-demo/test/link-index.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts`
  - [x] `pnpm typecheck`
  - [x] `pnpm test`
  - [x] `pnpm build`
  - [x] `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-electron-demo build`
  - [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo:
    - Opened `apps/electron-demo/sample-vault`
    - Opened `ghost-demo.md`
    - Verified unresolved links appear under the `Broken links` section in the Backlinks panel
    - Verified clicking a broken link jumps to the link position in the editor

  - [x] New dependencies: none
  - [x] No build artifacts committed (`dist/`, `dist-electron/`, compiled `.js` from `.ts`)
  - [x] No secrets / `.env` / personal vault data committed

  ## Checklist

  - [x] Title follows Conventional Commits
  - [x] Public API changes update package README / types — not applicable, no public package API changes
  - [x] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` — not applicable
  - [x] New capability / breaking change → OpenSpec proposal linked — not applicable, this is an electron-demo enhancement using existing architecture
  - [x] Change aligns with project scope
